verdict.rationale: Fathom's per-endpoint API reference pages (.md) embed OpenAPI-style YAML fragments (operationId, parameter name and description), so machine-readable spec content exists in the product's own docs. However, no complete downloadable spec was found: probes of the standard openapi.json and swagger.json paths all returned 404, and llms.txt is a docs index, not an API spec. missing for 10: a single downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file at a documented URL, documentation pointing users to download it, and independent confirmation that a full spec is retrievable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
